run_plot_script: run the plot.py script to generate a 2x2 matplotlib figure comparing OpenMP, TBB, Cpp-Taskflow, and sequential task frameworks
summarize_plot_script: summarize the plot.py script which generates bar charts of dev cost and line plots of runtime for graph traversal and matrix wavefront benchmarks
review_plot_script: review the plot.py script that reads graph_algorithm.txt and matrix_operation.txt to produce benchmark comparison plots
refactor_plot_script: refactor the plot.py script to parameterize hardcoded costs and data file paths for reuse across different benchmark datasets
test_plot_script: test the plot.py script by providing sample graph_algorithm.txt and matrix_operation.txt files with four space-separated columns per line
